body: AMENDMENT after checking the Codex path: the asymmetry is sharper. NavigationIndex.annotationsFor explicitly falls back to the nearest annotated primary ancestor, while placementFor separately reports ViaAncestor. AppCompiler ignores that distinction when building selectedAnnotations/focusedAnnotations: it calls annotationsFor(originalAddress), so a Codex ViaAncestor is currently styled by SvgDom as ordinary selected/focused and receives aria-pressed=true / aria-current=true on the ancestor fragment. Atlas ViaAncestor gets no graphic treatment; Codex ViaAncestor gets an identity-misleading ordinary treatment. The repair should therefore consume each compiler-provided SelectionPlacement for both faces and preserve three distinct presentation states: OnMark ordinary, ViaAncestor proxy, OffProjection none. exactAnnotationsFor already exists if direct-only lookup is needed. This reinforces the need for a cross-face law rather than an Atlas-only patch.
